words.trans: adj. 受惊的，被吓慌的
examples: The three of them stood outside the kitchen window, eyes like spooked deer.
The horse got spooked by a plastic bag and reared up.

words.trans: 详尽地、事无巨细地（成熟、高频的固定搭配/惯用词组，但算不上成语习语）
examples: Maggie relayed everything they knew in great detail.
She described the suspect in great detail to the police.

words.trans: adj. 不带感情的；就事论事的；平铺直叙、平淡客观的
examples: He took everything down with the same matter-of-fact tone as a missing-cat report.
In a matter-of-fact way, she explained what had gone wrong.

words.trans: 保留通话，让对方在线等待（不挂断）（客服、电话高频）
examples: I'm just going to put you on hold for a second.
The operator put me on hold while she checked the records.

words.trans: n.[不可数] 行话；专业术语；圈内黑话（外人听不懂）
examples: Beneath the air force jargon was a simple and clear message.
The report was full of legal jargon that ordinary people couldn't follow.

words.trans: Beneath + 表层外壳（话语/外表/伪装），+ 真实内核：在……的表象外壳之下，是……真相（beneath the jargon 在行话表象之下；beneath his smile 在笑容之下）
examples: Beneath the jargon was a simple message: mind your own business.
Beneath his tough exterior, he was actually quite shy.

words.trans: 到了这个地步；在这种情形下；此时此刻
examples: I can't give you a crime number at this point.
At this point in the game, there was nothing more they could do.

words.word: Is there anything else I can help you with
words.trans: 教科书级标准客服套话，英语客服极高频。还有其他什么我可以帮您的吗？
examples: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
'Here's your change. Is there anything else I can help you with?'

words.trans: 在某事上帮某人
examples: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Can I help you with those heavy bags?

words.trans: n.（航空）副翼
examples: Skylark had suffered a broken aileron in the crash-landing.
The pilot checked the ailerons before takeoff.

words.trans: v.（使）浸满水；大量进水，吸饱水而变沉重失灵
examples: Maggot's waterlogged outboard was another matter.
The basement was waterlogged after the flood.

words.trans: 摆放；摊开；陈列（实物），把东西铺开摆好
examples: Tom laid out his tools and settled down to the task.
She laid out the clothes on the bed before packing.

words.trans: 静下心来专心着手做某事；安下心投入某项工作
examples: He put his overalls on and settled down to the task.
After the holiday, I need to settle down to some serious study.

words.trans: n. 虹吸管；导流管。v. ①用虹吸管抽取、虹吸导出液体 ②引申高频义：私自抽走、挪用（钱、资源、信息）（小说新闻极常用）
examples: He made a start by siphoning the fuel tank.
He siphoned the water out of the tank using gravity.

words.trans: v.（不稳而）倒下、倾倒；强调摇摇欲坠后翻倒（重心不稳失去平衡翻倒）。自带画面：先摇晃，然后才翻倒，不是一下子摔下去
examples: Unbalanced, he toppled against the engine stand.
The tall stack of boxes toppled over when the door slammed.

words.trans: v./n. 斥责，数落，训斥（语气重，但一般不吼叫怒骂；多指长辈对晚辈，批评行为）
examples: 'Archie, sit down!' Maggie scolded.
My mum always scolded me for coming home late.

words.trans: adj. 慌乱的；手足无措的；心烦意乱，被突发状况搞得心神大乱（侧重狼狈、心神被搅乱，不一定生气）
examples: Flustered, Tom began to pick up the engine parts.
She got all flustered when the interviewer asked a tricky question.

words.trans: （记忆）潮水般涌回来，往事一下子涌上心头
examples: The events of the last twenty-four hours came flooding back to him.
All the childhood memories came flooding back when he heard the song.

words.trans: v. 恐吓；胁迫；威逼，通过威慑让对方害怕、屈服
examples: She had been intimidated by Snakey.
The big man tried to intimidate the shopkeeper into silence.

words.trans: adv. 语气生硬、粗声粗气地说话，不是发火，只是语调粗粝简短
examples: 'The water is heavier so it settles on the bottom,' he explained gruffly.
'Go away,' he said gruffly without looking up.

words.trans: n. 火花塞（内燃机零件）
examples: He began to loosen a spark plug with a spanner.
The mechanic replaced all four spark plugs.

words.trans: n. 软木塞（酒瓶、油箱、容器的瓶塞，航海、维修场景高频）
examples: A metal cylinder about the size of two corks put end to end.
She pulled the cork out of the wine bottle.

words.trans: 弹到位，猛地弹开、自动弹到工作位置
examples: A pair of rotor blades sprung into position with a click.
The seats spring into position when you press the button.

words.trans: v.（风、气流）吹乱，拂乱（毛发、头发）
examples: The machine lifted into the air, ruffling her hair with the breeze of the rotors.
The wind ruffled the feathers of the pigeon on the sill.

words.trans: 动能，物体运动而具备的能量
examples: The batteries are charged by kinetic energy.
A moving object stores kinetic energy.

words.trans: 从某处一把抓出来、拽出（小说高频）
examples: Tom said, plucking it from the space between them.
She plucked a grape from the bunch and ate it.

words.trans: 把A精准卡入、嵌入B的槽位里面
examples: He slotted Gnat into the tube again.
Slot the USB drive into the port at the front.

words.trans: 能完成任务、够用、能派上用场。可达成目标把活干完，不一定“刚好凑活够”；感情中性，常暗含不一定华丽、不完美，但功能够用
examples: 'It does the job,' said Tom.
The old laptop is slow, but it does the job for writing.

words.trans: 且不说别的；此外
examples: Apart from anything else, he makes the best cakes you've ever tasted.
Apart from anything else, it's too far to walk in this rain.

words.trans: 拜访某人/造访某地，固定习语
examples: It's time we paid a visit to Jim Rothwell.
We paid a visit to the local museum on Sunday.
